XB4GS9ShBRE.basis.glb_wardrobe.lang_desc: wardrobe which is located below the flower, to the right of the bed, and above the pillow. it is a grey dresser with a mirror above it.

XB4GS9ShBRE.basis.glb_bed.lang_desc: king size bed in the room. locate the bed by first finding the wardrobe, which is towards the right side of the frame. then, move downwards and slightly to the left to find the blankets thrown on the bed. the bed is situated towards the bottom left corner of the room.

queen-sized bed. go to the area where the wardrobe is located. move towards the nightstand. the bed is positioned near the nightstand, towards the right side and slightly above. pay attention to the pillow, which is positioned on the bed.

XB4GS9ShBRE.basis.glb_cabinet.lang_desc: the dresser with a mirror on it. it is located next to the window curtain and there is a flower nearby.
cabinet located to the right of the clothes and below the bath towels.
the wooden cabinet with a flat screen tv. it is located to the right side of the painting and below the led tv.
the wooden cabinet with a clock on it. the cabinet is located on the left side of the frame next to a chair.
built-in cabinet located near a window curtain, table, and chair in the room.
wood cabinets that are located near the sink, oven and stove, and oven vent.
cabinet located to the right of the dishwasher and below the sink.
the wooden cabinet with a tv on it, located above the electrical box.

XB4GS9ShBRE.basis.glb_clothes.lang_desc: clothes in good condition. the clothes are located inside the cabinet, which is positioned below the basket and to the right of the box.

XB4GS9ShBRE.basis.glb_couch.lang_desc: beige couch with red pillows located near the table lamp, painting, pillow, and lamp.
brown leather couch in the room. it is located near the table and armchair.

XB4GS9ShBRE.basis.glb_table.lang_desc: wooden table in a dining room. the table is located on the left side of the painting and below the flower. it is also positioned to the right of the chair.
the small table positioned near the four chairs.

XB4GS9ShBRE.basis.glb_oven and stove.lang_desc: oven and stove, which is located near the cabinet and oven vent. look for a stainless steel oven and stove in the vicinity of the cabinet and oven vent.
